message:
Here is a check on OSPF roles before we look at LSAs.

```quiz
{"mode":"practice","questions":[{"type":"fill","text":"On a broadcast segment OSPF elects a [[DR|designated router]] and a [[BDR|backup designated router]], and area [[0|0.0.0.0]] is the backbone every other area connects to.","explanation":"The DR and BDR cut the number of adjacencies on a shared segment; every non-backbone area attaches to area 0."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."}]}
```
